header.function_name: XD10 ASN Cross Dock Creation Screen

objective: To get the crossdock customer orders for a Delivery Date and Rit and pre-map them to supplier POs ([Search], XD09 Mapping Customer Order and PO Batch).

To display the delivery plan per Part Number + Customer Order Date with the supplier cases in receiving scan order (Case Qty, PO Readiness, ASN options, ASN Status Ready / Partially Ready / Not Ready). Units fully Created or without any pre-mapped case are not listed.
To let the D/S team (super admin) see the units of all suppliers, the destination detail and hold / release a destination of a unit.

To tick the supplier cases to send (check box per case, from case 1, cases that belong together) of one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant, map them to their POs (TB_R_INSTRUCTION), review the cases, download the case labels and submit the ASN.
Submit ASN runs in the background with a Submit ID and follows the existing ASN submit of NSP (refer 5.7).

Submit ASN (decided 20-Oct, existing structure G-System SPS DB): one TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST row per Pra Daily Order manifest of the cases (same ASN_NO) and one TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART row per manifest item and case; the ASN number and the case numbers (case label) are auto generated and their last sequence is saved in TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ; PART_NAME from TB_M_PART_MASTER.

buttons.name: Hold / Release (D/S)
buttons.function: D/S team only: set HOLD_FLAG of every order line of the destination (part number + customer order date + destination) to 'Y' (hold) or 'N' (release).

buttons.name: Create ASN
buttons.function: Check that the selected units are of one supplier and not held, map the chosen blocks to their POs (insert TB_R_INSTRUCTION) and open the Case List sub screen.

buttons.name: Back
buttons.function: Return from the Case List to ASN Crossdock Creation without submitting; the rows of TB_R_INSTRUCTION are deleted and the mapping is released.

buttons.name: Download Case Label

buttons.name: Submit ASN
buttons.function: Ask for confirmation, then hand the ASN to the submit process with a Submit ID (refer 5.7); the result is written to the log.

screen_mode_remarks: 1) Each unit row shows its supplier case rows in scan order (XD09). The check box of a case is enabled only when the case and every earlier case have a PO (Ready, message no. 2 as tooltip otherwise).

2) Cases that belong together (Case Group = GROUP_SEQ of XD09, the cases up to a CUT_FLAG Y; not shown as a column) are always sent together, so that at receiving every destination completes its warehouse case. The ticked cases of a unit start at case 1: ticking case n ticks the earlier cases and the other cases of its group (message no. 10); unticking case n unticks its group and the later cases. The unit check box ticks all Ready cases. Units of different Customer Order Dates and Part Numbers can be ticked together.

3) The supplier sees the unit rows and their case rows (Case, Qty, Remaining Qty (not assigned), PO, PO Status, check box) without destinations; the Content of a case (destinations, customer orders), the destination detail and Hold / Release are shown to the D/S team only.
4) Search is enabled when Delivery Date is filled and a Rit is available (message no. 5 otherwise).
5) One ASN is for one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant: the D/S team may tick units of several suppliers, [Create ASN] then shows message no. 9.

items: Customer Order Date (today, D) → PO Date (tomorrow, D+1): one PO per Part Number per Customer Order Date.

Total customer order qty of all destinations per Part Number and Customer Order Date = total PO qty of that PO. When the PO qty is lower: abnormality; the rest comes in a split PO, the customer orders without PO wait (Not Ready) until the next PO is issued.
One customer order line can be in different ASNs (its cases split). When G-System receives them separately, the line is split in H0253 (new SERIAL_NO); each part stays linked to its ASN (XD08).
PO_MAPPED_FLAG is set by [Create ASN] ('Y' when the whole line is in the ASN; a draft not submitted is released by XD08).
Ready cases of the delivery plan are sent following the cut (CUT_FLAG): the supplier selects from case 1 up to a cut; the cases between two cuts are sent together.
On first display Delivery Date = today (business date), Rit = first rit of the date, Route displayed (disabled). The delivery plan is empty.

[Search] runs XD09 Mapping Customer Order and PO Batch (UISS XD09): the open qty of the H0253 customer orders with order status 7 and Hold Flag N, in the receiving scan order of G-System per Part Number + Customer Order Date, pre-mapped to the PO parts of the Pra Daily Order (PO date order), cut into supplier cases and blocks in the temporary table #TEMP_INSTRUCTION (pre-mapping only; nothing is saved yet). Supplier: units of the login Supplier Code + Plant; D/S team: all suppliers.

The delivery plan shows one row per Part Number + Customer Order Date, sorted Ready, Partially Ready, Not Ready, then Part Number ascending. Units without any pre-mapped case and units fully Created are not listed. Part Number and Status filters apply at once. No row: message no. 3.
Delivery Date and Rit do not filter the orders; they are carried to the ASN. Rit and Route come from the existing route master table.

Unit = Part Number + Customer Order Date. Scan order (decided 21-Oct): Allocation Priority (= Customer Order Date), Customer Code, Customer Order No, Customer Order Date, Customer Order Time, Destination Code, Detailed Item No, Serial No; at receiving the pcs are scanned in this fixed order.

Supplier case = PCS_CASE pcs in scan order; a case can hold several customer orders, POs and destinations. Case Qty = number of supplier cases; PO Readiness (case) = cases whose whole qty is pre-mapped to a PO.

The warehouse packs 1 case = 1 destination, so an ASN may stop only after a case where every destination of the unit is a multiple of PCS_CASE (valid cut). The cases up to a valid cut are a block = one ASN option step (e.g. VN 10, TH 6, VN 14: blocks case 1 | cases 2-3 | case 4 | case 5).

A block is Ready ('6') when it and every earlier block have a PO; otherwise Not Ready ('7'): blocks are never skipped. Unit: Ready (all blocks), Partially Ready (the first k blocks), Not Ready (first block; check box disabled, message no. 2).
Created: blocks in a submitted ASN are no longer in the delivery plan (shown in ASN Inquiry); the open qty of the unit is cut again from case 1 in the same order at the next [Search].

The D/S team can expand a unit: one row per destination with Case, Qty (pcs), Pcs/Case and Hold Flag; each destination can be expanded to its customer order lines (Customer Order No, Detailed Item No, Qty, PO No, PO Date). The supplier sees the header only.

Hold / Release is done per destination: it updates HOLD_FLAG of every order line of the unit and destination in TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (refer Data Edit Mapping). A held destination is not taken by Search; the unit is computed without it. A unit with all destinations on hold is shown as On Hold to the D/S team only.
HOLD_FLAG is 'N' when the line is first replicated (XD08) and is kept on the next replications.

The user ticks the supplier cases to send with the check box of each case row. Cases that belong together (Case Group = GROUP_SEQ of XD09, not shown) are always sent together, so that at receiving every destination completes its warehouse case. The ticked cases of a unit start at case 1: ticking a case ticks the earlier cases and the other cases of its group (message no. 10). Example: cases 2-3 belong together (D/S view: case 2 = VN 4 + TH 2) -> ticking case 2 gives cases 1-3; cases 1-2 alone are not possible. Only Ready cases can be ticked. One ASN is for one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant (existing rule): ticked units of more than one supplier give message no. 9 and nothing is created.

[Create ASN] does the real mapping of the chosen blocks in one transaction: the slices inserted into TB_R_INSTRUCTION (case and line sequence of XD09), MAPPED_QTY in the new table TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED, and PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'Y' on the H0253 lines that are now completely in TB_R_INSTRUCTION. Then the Case List opens.

Before mapping, the ticked units are re-checked in the same transaction (row lock on the H0253 lines): if a line got HOLD_FLAG = 'Y' after the unit was ticked (e.g. the D/S team held a destination in another session), the creation fails for the whole selection (also the units that are not held): message no. 8 (Hold), the delivery plan is refreshed automatically and all ticked units are unticked. If a unit is no longer Ready for another reason (changed by another user), message no. 7.

[Back] / [Cancel] on the Case List cancel the creation: the rows are deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to 'N' and MAPPED_QTY reduced again, so the blocks can be selected again. A draft left open (no Submit, no Cancel) is released by the next run of XD08 (every run releases all drafts, decided 23-Oct): the cases come back in the delivery plan and the supplier ticks them again.
The summary shows ASN No (assigned on submit), supplier, Delivery Date · Rit · Route of the Search, Delivery Qty (pcs) and number of cases.
Each case shows Case Number, Part Number and Qty; the expand shows PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item and PO Qty. Customer order data is not shown here.
[Download Case Label]: follows the existing case label of NSP.

[Submit ASN]: confirmation (message no. 4). Yes: the draft is handed with a Submit ID to the submit process (refer 5.7); the submit process follows the existing ASN. It reads TB_R_INSTRUCTION and inserts the existing tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART; ASN No and Case No follow the existing numbering (case number auto generated by checking the last sequence). The screen returns to the delivery plan and shows the Submit ID (message no. 6); there is no success popup. The result message is written by the submit process (5.7) to the existing log (Log Monitoring).

#TEMP_INSTRUCTION is temporary (pre-mapping of [Search]). TB_R_INSTRUCTION holds the mapping from [Create ASN] until submit or Back / Cancel. TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED is a new table for the mapped qty. Submitted ASNs are in TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST / PART and shown in ASN Inquiry (XD15).
Case number: the format follows the existing NSP case number; the last sequence is kept in the TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ (note only, not detailed here).
Cancel of an order is not done in NSP: it comes from the source (H0253 order status '2'); NSP only holds (HOLD_FLAG). Refer XD08 / XD11.
The prototype has a 'Business date' switch (PO release) and a 'View as' switch (Supplier / D/S team); they are not part of the real screen.

operation.text: 5.7 Submit ASN Process (backend, follows the existing ASN)

items: Re-check before the submit: the draft must still exist (not released by XD08) and every line of it must still have UPD_STATUS NULL and the same qty. Otherwise nothing is submitted, the draft is released and message no. 11 is shown; the supplier searches again.
The screen generates the Submit ID, writes the start message to the log (LOG2) and starts the submit process. The screen returns to the delivery plan and shows the Submit ID.

Read the rows of the Submit ID from TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one Supplier Code + Plant). Take the ASN No from the existing numbering and auto generate one Case No per case by checking the last sequence (TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ; format as existing).
Insert TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART (existing tables, refer Data Edit Mapping); write ASN_NO / CASE_NO back to TB_R_INSTRUCTION.

No error: commit, write the result (LOG3) and end (LOG4) messages. Error: roll back, release the mapping (delete the rows from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to 'N', MAPPED_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED reduced again), write the error (LOG5). Exit.
Submit ASN runs as a batch so the screen does not wait; the user sees the Submit ID and checks the result in Log Monitoring. No success popup is shown on the screen.
The log follows the existing NSP log (same table and columns); the Submit ID is the key to find the run.
All-or-nothing: on error nothing is saved and the mapping made by [Create ASN] is released (rows deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION), so the units can be selected again.

The ASN is saved in the existing tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST / TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART; the case number is auto generated by checking the last sequence kept in the TB_R_CASE_LABEL_LAST_SEQ (format as existing, not detailed here).
The submit process (Submit ID, batch call, log) follows the existing ASN submit of NSP.
Dummy example of [Create ASN] (case packing, TB_R_INSTRUCTION rows, flags, Case List, scenarios): see sheet Sample Input.

tables.name: #TEMP_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Temporary table of one Search run (session): the open qty of the customer order lines (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N) in scan order, pre-mapped to the supplier POs (Pra Daily Order) and cut into supplier cases and blocks. One row per line x PO x supplier case; PO_NO NULL for the qty still without a PO. Columns proposed.
columns: Scan order of the line within the unit (refer 4.1)
Customer Order Date (H0253.ORDER_DT; unit and scan key 3)
Order status qty of the customer order line (H0253.ORDER_STATUS_QTY)
Qty of the line not yet in TB_R_INSTRUCTION (sent or in an open Case List)
Qty of this slice (line x PO x supplier case)
Supplier PO number (Pra Daily Order Manifest); NULL while not assigned
Manifest item number (Pra Daily Order Part)
Order date of the PO (PO Date)
Order qty of the PO part
Pcs per case of the part (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.PCS_CASE)
Supplier case of the slice within the unit (PCS_CASE pcs in scan order)
Sequence of the slice within the case
Cumulative qty of the destination within the unit up to this slice
Fill of the warehouse case (1 case = 1 destination) of the destination after this slice: 1..PCS_CASE, starts again after PCS_CASE
'Y' on the last slice of a case after which the ASN may stop (every destination a multiple of PCS_CASE)
Case Group (block) of the slice: the cases up to and including a valid cut; the cases of a group are sent together
Status of the block: '6' Ready (the block and every earlier block have a PO) / '7' Not Ready

tables.name: TB_R_INSTRUCTION

intro: Dummy data. Supplier 50221 plant 1, Delivery Date 16-Oct-2026, Rit 1, Route SD01. Pcs/Case = 6 for PART-X and PART-Y.
The supplier ticks PART-X 14-Oct-2026 and PART-Y 14-Oct-2026 (both Ready) on the delivery plan and clicks [Create ASN].

Rule: per Part Number + Customer Order Date + destination the order lines (FIFO, then by PO) are packed in cases of pcs/case. A case can hold several customer orders and several POs of the same destination; a line that does not fit continues in the next case.

sections.title: A. Input: pre-mapping of the ticked units (XD09, #TEMP_INSTRUCTION, one row per customer order line x PO)
B. Input: PO parts before [Create ASN] (Pra Daily Order: manifest with CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X', part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART)
C. Case packing (Vietnam 18 pcs = 3 cases, Thailand 6 pcs = 1 case, Philippines 6 pcs = 1 case)
D. Result: rows inserted into TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one row per case x customer order line x PO; ASN_NO / CASE_NO filled on submit)
E. Result: other tables changed in the same transaction
F. Result on the screen: Case List (Draft)
rows: Case Number, Part Number, Qty (6 each); the expand button shows the PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item and PO Qty of the case (Case 2: CO-14101 + CO-14102 of PO-DMY-09001; Case 3: CO-14102 + CO-14103 of PO-DMY-09002)
Confirmation: Submit ASN? 5 cases (30 pcs) will be created into ASN-50221-261016-001, delivery 16-Oct-2026 · Rit 1.

sections.title: G. Scenarios
rows: Create ASN with PART-X 14-Oct and PART-Y 14-Oct ticked
Sections C to F: 5 cases, 7 rows in TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG Y, mapped qty added; Case List opens.
Submit ID handed to the submit process (5.7); ASN_NO and CASE_NO (existing sequence) are written back to the 7 rows; ASN status Created; PART-X / PART-Y 14-Oct are no longer listed.
The 7 rows are deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to N, MAPPED_QTY back to 0; the units are listed again as Ready.
The D/S team holds Thailand of PART-X 14-Oct after the supplier ticked it
MSG8; the whole create fails (also PART-Y), nothing is inserted, the delivery plan is refreshed and all units are unticked.
PART-X 14-Oct is no longer Ready (e.g. a PO was changed) when [Create ASN] is clicked
MSG7; nothing is inserted; the delivery plan is refreshed.
D/S team ticks PART-X (supplier 50221-1) and a unit of supplier 50330-2
Roll back: nothing is kept; error message on the screen and Log FAILED.
